system.description:
Drese awaits perched on a corner of the Victorian era building in Lordan City, in the Land of Moons. A large scar across his shoulder, he waits impatiently, while biting his lips in frustration. “Those bastards won’t get away.” He mutters to himself before he sees his target, dart from inside of a building, making a mad dash into the nearby alleyway.

Drese follows closely by leaping and making a small clicking sound, like that of a bat, tracking him via echolocation along. The man makes multiple turns, but is quickly cut off by Drese who quickly descends upside down with his crimson red scarf dangling below him. “You thought you could sell that poison in our village, then just get to go home like nothing happened. Fat chance.” Drese barks while touching down to the ground slowly. The man laughs “You think I’m the first boy? No, I won’t be last either. Look to smooth things over, how about I donate some ryo to your village you could use it.”

Drese snickers before smiling with two large fangs protruding from where his K9’s should be. “Nah, I don’t need it. I’m bout to have a meal in a minute anyway.” Drese says. “Do you know how much you could buy with what I’m offering!? I could feed all of you shinobi, what more could you want” the man barks back. Drese’s eyes flickers red “To eat the rich.” Drese says before dashing forward.

-Otsohi Suzumaru

Shinobi Historia, Ch. 12 excerpt

Nocturnal Hunters

Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Schmeelo

The Vesper Clan is a clan that originally hails from the Land of Moons, but has since migrated to the Land of Water. Their origins trace back to a Sage know for his association with the Bat tribe. The Clan is often associated with bat like traits and features. Red eyes, darker skin, more pointed ears, and fanglike teeth and a preference to the night over the day.

Vesper Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Cha, +1 Str or Dex

Speed: 35 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Stealth

Nocturnal Sight: Vesper Clansmen have 60 feet of Darkvision.

Nocturnal Movement: While in dim light or darkness, a Vesper Clansmen’s movement cannot provoke attacks of opportunity.

Nocturnal-Speak: You can speak to and understand Rats, Bats, Snakes, Wolves and Predator Birds.

| Crimson Hemorrhage – Claws of Night / Max Ranks: 5, [Physical] / Once per turn, a creature with Crimson Hemorrhage takes 1d6 necrotic damage for each rank it has, when it makes a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw. / A creature with Crimson Hemorrhage that takes Unarmed or Weapon damage from a hostile creature, heals the attacking creatures hit points by 2. / At the end of a creature with Crimson Hemorrhage’s turn, if it have ranks of Bleed, it lose those ranks of Bleed and gain an equal number of ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage. This does not occur if it have 5 ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage. |

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Vesper Features

Claws of Night

1st Level Clan Feature

One of the Vesper Clans defining physical traits are their nails, black as midnight and able to be sharpened to rival the edge of a Kunai. The Clan has developed a special combat style utilizing their claws, or their claws in conjunction with a weapon from the Blade weapon group. While in combat you can sharpen and elongate your claws and enter your Claws of Night Taijutsu stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 1d8 and your [Unarmed Damage] type becomes Slashing.

Once per turn, when inflicting the Bruised condition, you can change it to be 1 rank of Bleed instead.

Once per turn, if you deal [Weapon Damage], with a weapon from the Blade weapon group that doesn’t have the Two-Handed property or [Unarmed Damage], you can force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save, gaining a rank of Crimson Hemorrhage on a failure.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Echo of Night

1st Level Clan Feature

The Vesper clan has many special traits due to their unique heritage, but the one thing that separates them from the pack is their unique association with sound-based techniques. They are able to emulate bats with terrifying accuracy, attuning to the world by both sound and shadows.

Echolocation. By spending 1 Bonus action, for the next minute, you have 30 feet of blindsight that functions only while you can hear and it is suppressed if you are Deafened or under an effect that muffles sound. You also have a rank of Mastery to Perception checks that rely on sound.

Pinging. As a bonus action, you emit a soft click: choosing a point you can see within 30 feet. All creatures within 10 feet of that point are Pinged until the start of your next turn. Attacks you make against Pinged creatures cannot be made at disadvantage. The range of this ping increases to 45 feet at 7th level and 60 feet at 15th level.

Sonar Reprisal. Creatures Pinged by you, triggers attacks of opportunities for allied creatures within range of your Echolocation if they are invisible or unseen by them.

Vampyric Physique

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Vesper clans unique physical physique places them into a category all their own with their physical strength. They dominate other shinobi with feats of physical strength and agility that seems, simply inhuman. You gain two of these options and another of your choice at 7th and 15th levels.

Anchored Steps

Creatures or effects that would attempt to move you against your will make their checks to do so at disadvantage. You also make saving throws or checks to resist being moved at advantage.

Dominating Stability

Creatures struggle to challenge you physically. You gain a rank of mastery to Strength Saving throws.

Dinner Bell

Combat for you feels like a chance to feed on the failure of your foes. When initiative is rolled, you can spend your Reaction. If you do, you gain a rank of Mastery to all d20 based rolls you make before the end of your next turn.

Gravestone Dragging

You are physically superior to most other shinobi of a similar stature to you. Increase your Bulk by +5. Additionally, when attempting to move while grappling a creature, moving does not count as difficult terrain for you.

Inhuman Stamina

Your physical stamina cannot be compared. Checks and saving throws made to resist gaining ranks of Exhaustion are made at advantage. Additionally, if you spend an Action to Dash, you can spend your Bonus Action during the same turn to Dash again.

Launching Throw

Objects, items or tools that allow you to throw them, have an increased range of +20 feet. Additionally, you gain a rank of Mastery to Shove attempts. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th and three ranks at 15th level.

Vaulted Limbs

When chakra movement techniques aren’t available, the old fashion way is more than doable for you. You gain a Climbing speed equal to your movement speed. Additionally, reduce the number of fall damage dice rolled by an amount equal to half your level.

Mesmeric Sonance

3rd Level Clan Feature

The clans close association with the Bat sage tribe isn’t just skin deep. Its become a near symbiotic relationship, so much so that the clan has learned ways to utilize sound and turn your enemies vision against themselves. You learn either the Hypnotic Voice or Hypnotic Gaze ability. Beginning at 11th level, you gain the ability, you didn’t select at 3rd level.

| #### Hypnotic Gaze: GM Notes / This feature is left open ended to facilitate Roleplay or even tactical Combat moments. This does leave open opportunities for some disruptive players to attempt to force scenarios or actions on an NPC such as “Kill yourself” or other detestable commands. It is suggested to completely rule against these scenarios and even punish the character within the narrative for attempting it. As always the GM is final rules arbiter for open ended effects and abilities such as these. |

Hypnotic Voice. As an action, you release a screech like sound wave, that overwhelms the senses of all creatures of your choice within a 20-foot cone originating from you, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. This ability counts as a Genjutsu of a rank equal to the highest rank you can cast, but uses your highest jutsu saving throw DC. Increase the size of this cone +20 feet at 11th level.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Critical Success: The affected creature is able to resist this abilities effects.

Success: The Affected creature becomes Confused until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures become Confused and Dazed.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creatures are also Slowed.

Hypnotic Gaze. As an action, you stare into the eyes of a single creature you can see within 30 feet of you, release your compelling chakra into them, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw. This ability counts as a Genjutsu of a rank equal to the highest rank you can cast, that you must maintain concentration on, but uses your highest jutsu saving throw DC. A creature that fails or Critically fails cannot suffer its failure or critical failure effects again, until you complete a rest.

Critical Success: The affected creature is able to resist this abilities effects.

Success: The Affected creature becomes Charmed until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures become Charmed and while charmed must spend its Movement and Actions for the next minute obeying one command you give it, that must be done as part of this ability. Once the command is complete, the Charmed condition ends on them.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creature remains charmed, obeying following orders that you give as a Bonus action on your turns for the next minute. Creatures compelled in this way that take damage, can remake their saving throws once per turn.

Nocturnal Dominion

7th Level Clan Feature

Using the secret techniques of the Vesper clan, you are able to wrestle control of the Shadows upon the battlefield, and twist them into aspects of fear and extensions of yourself.

When you complete a rest, you may select two of the listed abilities, being able to utilize them until you complete your next rest. These abilities use your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus, if they require an attack or saving throw.

Umbral Domain

As an Action, select a point you can see within 60 feet of you. A 30-foot radius zone of shadows manifest for the next minute. Spaces within this zone is treated as Chakra based darkness and difficult terrain. You can see normally in this affected area and its area is not difficult terrain for you. When a hostile creature begins its turn in the affected area, they must make a Wisdom saving throw. This ability counts as a C-Rank Genjutsu, with the Visual and Tactile keywords. Its damage increases by 1d8 at 11th and 15th levels.

Success: Affected creature takes half of 4d8 psychic damage.

Failure: Affected creature takes 4d8 psychic damage and gains 1 rank of Demoralized.

Critical Failure: Affected creature takes 6d8 psychic damage and gains 2 rank of Demoralized.

Dread Weave

Once per turn, when you cast a Genjutsu with the Visual or Auditory keywords, you can layer abject terror into it. A creature that fails their saving throw, gains 1 rank of Shaken. Creatures that critically fail their saving throw gains 1 rank of Shaken and become Berserked.

| #### Umbral Monarch / Battle Amp / You become a shadow wreathed beast of the night. / Nocturnal Wings. You gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed, with wings attached to your arms / Sonar. You always have the benefit of Echolocation, and can use Pinging once per turn, on your turn at no action cost. / Beast Claws. Your [Unarmed Damage], while in your Claws of the Night stance, increases by +2. This increases to +4 at 15th level. / Fearless. If you begin your turn with 1 rank of Demoralized or Shaken, you reduce the ranks of said conditions to 0. / Crimson Feast. Once per turn, when you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a creature with ranks of Crimson Hemorrhage, you can reduce their ranks of said condition to 0. If you do, you regain 1d10 hit points for each rank removed. / Sonic Lance. As an Action, you can fire a 60-foot long, 5-foot-wide beam of destructive sound force. All creatures in the affected area must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 6d6 force damage and are Deafened until the end of their next turn, or half as much damage on a success. / Umbral Shockwave. As an Action, you release a Pulse of darkness centered on you, filling a 20-foot radius. Creatures in range must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. This counts as a Genjutsu, with the Visual, Auditory and Tactile keywords. / Success: Affected creature are Dazzled until the end of their next turn. / Failure: Affected creature are Blinded, until the end of their next turn. / Critical Failure: Same as failure, but are also Confused for the same duration. |

Additionally, if the creature that failed or critically failed their saving throw has 2 or more ranks of Demoralized, increase the ranks of Shaken inflicted by this effect by +1.

Terror-Borne Constructs

When you summon a Creature as a result of a Genjutsu you cast or summon a creature with the Illusory Construct trait, it gains the following benefits, while they remain summoned;

They gain additional Hit points equal to 5 + your level.

The first time they deal damage each turn, increase the damage they deal by +2. This increases to +4 at 11th level.

Mist Step

As a bonus action, while not in direct sunlight, you transform into a swirl of mist and teleport into a space you can see that can hold you, up to 40 feet away. Increase the distance you can teleport in this way by +20 feet at 11th level.

Once you teleport using this feature, you cannot do so again, until you cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu of C-Rank or higher that costs chakra.

Vapor Reprieve

When you take damage, you can spend your reaction to transform a portion of the damaged area into mist softening the impact. When you do, you reduce the damage taken by 2 damage dice. This increases to 3 damage dice at 15th level.

Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again, until you cast a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu of C-Rank or higher that costs chakra.

Umbral Transmutation

7th Level Clan Feature

Using the secret technique of the Vesper, you are able to transform into a bat-wreathed terror, longer hair, completely red eyes, fur covers your torso, shins and forearms and your ears grow into points. As a bonus action, for the next minute, you enter your Umbral Monarch state. Once you enter this state, you cannot do so again until you complete a Long Rest. If you enter this state again before completing a long rest, you gain 1 rank of exhaustion.

Nocturnal Discussions

11th Level Clan Feature

Both halves of your clan yells out to you during tense social discussion. One half asks for patience, to follow the teachings of the Bat-Sage and to show humility. The other side demands swift action, and to overwhelm with societal force. Each a compelling option, both with their own upsides and down. When you enter a social encounter, you can decide to either; Be Patient, Impatient, or neither.

If you choose to be Patient, you cannot gain jutsu or feature based bonuses for the current social encounter. But in exchange for your patience, you gain a Will of Night, which lasts until spent and you can only have one of at any given time. When used grants you two ranks of mastery to all Wisdom and Charisma based skill-based checks for 1 minute.

If you choose to be Impatient, you gain a rank of Mastery to one skill of your choice until the conclusion of this social encounter. But in exchange for your impatience, if you fail 2 or more checks during this encounter, you and your team have the Social Attitude of the creature you were interacting with, reduce by 2 ranks.

Nocturnal Supremacy

15th Level Clan Feature

You’ve become the perfect symbol for the Vespers. A lodestar to aspire to become. A myth among the living and a legend for those not yet born. But this perfection isn’t absolute. You must make a choice. When you reach this level, choose between Dominion and Requiem. An Ultimatum in choice for which part of your clan you wish to represent. Once you make this choice, you can only change it by completing a ritual to do so, which can be done as part of a Full-Rest.

Dominion

You embody the shadows and fear, and the ability to compel at will.

When you roll initiative, you begin to radiate a small aura of shadows around yourself as the range of your blind sight from the Echolocation ability is increased to 40 feet.

Additionally, If you would ever teleport into a space that is dimly lit or in darkness that is adjacent to a creature that is Berserked, Charmed, Confused, Demoralized or Shaken, you can, as part of the same action used to teleport, force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, select one creature they can see that is in initiative. They must spend their movement, action and bonus action to harm the select creature. When they have dealt damage to the target creature 3 times, this effect ends on them. A creature that passes their save by 5 or more, becomes immune to this effect until you complete a rest.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Requiem

You embody the concept whispered about in your clan, the Apex Vampyr. A predator and stalker of the night that feeds on crimson ichor to sustain themselves.

When you roll initiative, your claws become crimson red and grow in length. While in the Claws of Night stance, or while in your Umbral Monarch state, you gain a +15 bonus to your movement speed and when you take the Attack action, can make one additional attack as part of that Action.

Also, creatures with ranks of Bleed or Crimson Hemorrhage, grant you a +1 bonus to your unarmed attacks or weapon attacks critical threat range.

Additionally, as a Bonus Action, creatures with ranks of Bleed or Crimson Hemorrhage within 30 feet of you have their blood siphoned from them, as they lose all ranks of the listed conditions. For every rank of the listed conditions removed, you regain 1d6 hit points or gain 6 Temporary hit points, your choice.
